config.label: Smarter Weather API key (sw_live_* or sw_test_*) with the 'mcp' scope
config.description: Smarter Weather API key (sw_live_* or sw_test_*) with the 'mcp' scope. When set, the bridge skips the OAuth flow and forwards the key as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' on every proxied request. When unset, the bridge runs the full MCP OAuth 2.1 + PKCE client and caches tokens at ~/.mcp-auth/. Mint keys at https://smarterweather.com/developers/api-keys.

config.label: Override the target MCP endpoint
config.description: Override the target MCP endpoint. Useful for development or staging against a non-production sw-mcp deployment. Precedence: positional argument > SMARTERWEATHER_MCP_URL > package default (https://mcp.smarterweather.com/mcp).
